codeReview.summary: The feature implementation fully covers all expected behaviors specified in the feature description. The grupos page at /grupos includes CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete groups), member management (add/remove customers to groups), search functionality, and uses existing UI components. The implementation follows React Router v7 conventions and integrates with the existing backend API.

issues.description: Uses direct fetch() calls instead of TanStack Query hooks. The codebase standard (documented in library/architecture.md and used by useCustomers hook) is to use TanStack Query for server state. While the inline fetch works functionally, it doesn't follow the established pattern for consistency.

No offline-first check before API calls. The AGENTS.md specifies 'Offline-first: check isOnline() before API calls', but the implementation makes direct API calls without checking connectivity. This may cause issues when the app is offline.
Hardcoded API fallback URL 'http://localhost:5201' should use the existing pattern from the codebase for API URL resolution.

summary: PASS - The feature implementation fully delivers the required functionality: route /grupos with group list, create/edit/delete forms, member management UI, and confirmation dialogs. All expected behaviors are present. The code has some deviations from established patterns (TanStack Query usage, offline-first checks) but these are non-blocking issues that don't prevent the feature from working.
